title: verify/1: the answer of `mzlab-cli flow verify RECORD --json`
description: Whether the fingerprints of an mzrun record match its own content. `problems` names each part that does not match (`self_sha256`, `plan_sha256`, `results_digest`, `entity:NAME`); empty when `ok`. Exit 0 when ok, 3 otherwise. Code: crates/mzlab-cli/src/flow_mzrun.rs.

self_sha256.description: the fingerprint computed from the record
